_comment: Pools to hide even when they look active in the data — deprecated-but-functional venues a build can't detect. Add: a DefiLlama pool id (uuid) to poolIds; a "project|chain|SYMBOL" key (case-insensitive, SYMBOL = DefiLlama's raw symbol) to keys; or a Morpho vault address (from its app.morpho.org URL) to morphoVaults. Anything listed here is dropped from the rankings.
